args.body: Use the separately queued official payout capture only after its receipt confirms committed bytes. Verify the minimum balance, currency, payout timing and any Canadian payout costs stated there. Reuse the existing USD 9 and USD 19 transaction scenarios and compute whole sales needed to reach the documented threshold only if the fee assumptions and currency support the calculation. Keep threshold accumulation and actual payout separate. If the seller-fit mission has already closed, preserve the payout excerpt and calculation as supplemental evidence without reopening its completed scope. Bind any conditional listing draft to the verified original-fixture manifest when available. No activation, contact, spending or publication.
